blockers: Whether Cloudflare is configured to strip or normalize client-supplied CF-Connecting-IP/X-Forwarded-For before the tunnel, and whether the origin accepts only tunnel traffic, are deployment facts outside the repository.

validation_plan.deployment: From an external host, send requests with forged CF-Connecting-IP/X-Forwarded-For values and confirm the effective throttle identity remains the tunnel peer unless the peer is trusted; also verify firewall/tunnel settings deny direct origin access.
validation_plan.local: Read backend/proxy.py client_ip and peer_is_trusted_proxy paths, plus Caddy header_up handling and compose networking, without sending live traffic.

trace.description: Edge reverse proxy passes inbound client identity headers to the application.
Proxy helper inspects the immediate peer address against the trusted proxy list.
Throttle client identity falls back to TCP peer unless proxy trust is established.
